name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €88/MWh on 20 Nov, above the €70 Alert line, as Gulf shipping attacks continue
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €88.45/MWh on 20 Nov, about a third higher over three months and above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Tanker attacks around the Strait of Hormuz, including two incidents near Khasab on 21 Nov (US News/Reuters), keep Gulf LNG flows at risk going into winter.
for_you: Wholesale gas is expensive, which feeds through to household and business energy bills with a lag. Check Ofgem for current price cap levels.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures
US News (Reuters) — UK maritime agency reports two tanker incidents near Oman; Iran says vessel hit mine east of Hormuz

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
